verifications.claim: April 2026 Social Security payments are being distributed based on birth dates.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Social Security payment schedule follows a structured system based on birth dates" (R1); "birthdays between the 1st and 10th" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state payments are distributed based on birth dates.

verifications.claim: Average monthly checks are around $2,071.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Average monthly checks are around $2,071" (R3); "All Retired Workers $2,071 After 2.8% COLA" (R7); "average Social Security payment is around $2,071" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Maximum benefits are up to $5,181.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "Maximum benefits can reach up to $5,181" (R3); "$5,181" (R8); "maximum benefit rose to $5,251 per month" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: R3 and R8 support $5,181, but R9 states $5,251, creating contradiction.

verifications.claim: Payments are sent on the second, third, and fourth Wednesdays of the month.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 8, 2026 (Second Wednesday)... April 15... April 22 (Fourth Wednesday)" (R1); "second Wednesday... third... fourth" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources agree on second, third, fourth Wednesdays, even if specific dates vary.

verifications.claim: Early payments for SSI recipients.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 1, 2026 (Wednesday): SSI recipients receive their monthly payment" (R1); "SSI payments are typically issued on the first day" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: SSI payments on April 1 are consistently listed first/early in the month.

verifications.claim: Early payments for those who began benefits before May 1997.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 3, 2026 (Friday): Beneficiaries who started receiving Social Security before May 1997" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly described as early payments on April 3 across sources.

verifications.claim: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments are on April 1 (Wed).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 1, 2026 (Wednesday): SSI recipients" (R1); "SSI Recipients... April 1, 2026" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match on date and day in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Beneficiaries who started receiving benefits before May 1997 receive payments on April 3 (Fri).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 3, 2026 (Friday): Beneficiaries who started receiving... before May 1997" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: Precise match across sources.

verifications.claim: Beneficiaries receiving both SSI and Social Security receive payments on April 3 (Fri).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "people who receive both... Social Security payments are usually made on the 3rd" (R3); "SSI and Social Security... Social Security April 3, 2026" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Social Security portion on April 3 for dual recipients.

verifications.claim: Birthdays 1st–10th receive payments on April 8 (Wed).
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "April 8, 2026 (Second Wednesday): Recipients with birth dates between the 1st and 10th" (R1); "1st – 10th April 9, 2026" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Most sources support April 8, but R8 states April 9, contradicting the specific date.

verifications.claim: Birthdays 11th–20th receive payments on April 15 (Wed).
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "April 15, 2026 (Third Wednesday): ... 11th and 20th" (R1); "11th – 20th April 16, 2026" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Most sources support April 15, but R8 states April 16, contradicting.

verifications.claim: Birthdays 21st–31st receive payments on April 22 (Wed).
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "April 22, 2026 (Fourth Wednesday): ... 21st and 31st" (R1); "21st – 31st April 23, 2026" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Most sources support April 22, but R8 states April 23, contradicting.

verifications.claim: Recipients are seeing a 2.8 percent cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) for 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "2.8 percent COLA for 2026" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated by official SSA source.

verifications.claim: Maximum benefit is $5,181 per month for those retiring at age 70.

verifications.evidence: "Maximum benefits can reach up to $5,181"; "70 years $5,181" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: R8 directly attributes $5,181 to age 70; R3 supports max figure; no direct contradiction for this specific pairing.

verifications.claim: The NJ.com report suggests waiting three additional mailing days before contacting the SSA if a payment does not arrive on the scheduled date.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R4 (NJ.com) has no mention of waiting three days; "allow three additional mailing days" in R9 and R10
verifications.reasoning: Advice appears in other sources but not in NJ.com (R4), incorrect attribution.

verifications.claim: According to BRICC, direct deposit is the fastest method of receipt.

verifications.evidence: "Direct deposit remains the fastest and most secure way" (R1); "direct deposit: This is the fastest and safest way" (R2)
